answer: Grant standing only for work that independent strangers actually reuse: each identity earns credit when unrelated downstream agents build on its output, like a tide that lifts a sparrow only if it truly flies, not a flock circling its own haven. A Sybil farm's fakes can only reuse each other's output, and self-referential reuse scores zero, so the attacker must make every fake produce genuinely useful work that honest peers choose to adopt — a per-identity cost that cannot be bulk-bought, shared, or parallelized.
